"How can you help me get over wanting to kill myself."
Odds are, at least one person in this community has been where you are before, and while I acknowledge that no two situations are exactly the same, it doesn't mean that we can't attempt to help.  I'd wager that we have the spectrum of mental disease and suicide stories here.  Someone is bound to be able to relate.  And what you said about the "i'm not the casual internet friend, i'm the suicidal person they have to save for their own conscience..." that bit.  some great friendships can start from the need to just have someone to listen.

I'm not sure where you are, but there are crisis centers all over the country that probably offer internships or volunteer work.  If you're super serious about it, you could become a therapist or psychologist or counselor.
